description: The narrowest set the application runs on. A capability is a permanent grant to code that renders hostile input, so widening this is a Phase 2 proposal with an ADR (CLAUDE.md 7.6). Minimising, maximising and closing are NOT here: the controls ADR-0005 made ours act through a command of ours, so the webview never needs permission to do them. `allow-start-dragging` stays because it is what Tauri's own drag-region script calls. See issue #39.
